# Data
Sources:

Diet data from UK Data Service
National Food Survey (1974 to 2000)
~ 7,000 households per year, ~190,000 households total
One week journal of every food purchase 
Includes nutrient conversion information

Disease data from Institute for Health Metrics Evaluation (IHME)
Global Burden of Disease (GBD) study (1990 to 2023)
Summary Exposure Value risk rates
Pre-aggregated to all population per location

Pipeline:
National Food Survey data aggregated by household by year, 
aggregated years vertically unioned into time series data,
disease data joined on region and year.  

Units:
Food group rates normalized as proportion of daily calories.
Nutrient rates normalized as quantity per daily calories
Disease risk rates are summary exposure value (SEV), relative to total possible risk.

Ethics & responsible use: 
The data is used under a non-commercial educational license and comes anonymized and/or aggregated by the service providers to ensure confidentiality. Responsible use stems from upholding the listed terms of service provided from the UK Data Service.
